physical_accounting.deployment_rule: Each method bears the complete warm cost and its own conversion. Standalone attribution is full, batch attribution divides this setup by declared query count. Initial query cloning belongs to deployment; sibling-history cloning only to physical audit.
physical_accounting.physical_rule: One paid 32-cap warm trajectory per case/seed, with no 128 continuation. BALANCED, old STOP, and cached STOP each have one separate paid conversion. All history-branch suffix batch requests are physical draws, including repeated rows. Full benchmarks share one complete acquisition per case/seed.

scope: Retained root qualities and history traces only. Cached and original STOP require exact complete V17 observation and policy histories. Expected stage costs include deployment cache copying and updates; counterfactual sibling clones remain physical audit work. Stop events use retained true transition weights but are not optimality labels or confidence guarantees. Full empirical benchmarks have larger sample budgets.
